reasoning.changed_node: Accessor-owned functions are no longer exempted from unused-formal elimination, because the exemption guard inspects the function node instead of its accessor key.

fault.semantic_root_cause: The accessor exemption guard tests the function node rather than its parent accessor key, so it is unconditionally inert and an object-literal setter's mandatory formal is stripped as an unused trailing argument.

trigger.expected: accessor keeps its declared formal while the ordinary function's unused formal is removed
trigger.actual: IllegalStateException: set methods must have exactly one parameter
